changes: Original hand-painted surface atlas generated with built-in image_gen using the supplied environment screenshot for style only.
Clean large painted shapes, two broad baked light bands, cool shadows/warm edges, restrained AO; no extra realtime lights, outline or volume pass.
558 zero-area logical-part triangles removed; UVs, bounds and actual surface area preserved.
20 compatible modular parts, 24 FBX exports including independent gate frames/doors.
Example canyon route, clearing, cave, distant caldera and lava ribbon exported as real geometry, not a concept image.
limits: The generated cel kit is available through Git in a separate resource folder. The game consumer must apply the included optional style-switch patch to select it; no game logic was changed by this delivery.
The v3 part silhouettes are preserved. This change focuses on materials, cel shading and example layout.
Old 2D obstacle sprites are not restyled; their previous palette may differ until the game session updates them.
Cel illumination is baked in part space. Rotating a part also rotates its painted key light; a host cel shader or offline scene bake is needed for globally consistent moving lighting.
The independent example GLB has static sky/lava; the existing generator smoke/cloud animation APIs are unchanged and require the host to connect them when used.
The example has no game movement, tracking, battle, hazard triggers or collision components. Unity preview has a desktop free camera only.
No phone FPS, heat, physical tracking or stereoscopic performance test was performed.

git.commitMessage: scenegen style: anime cel volcano kit
git.pushVerification: Publishing session verifies the server ref after committing; the resulting SHA is recorded in the local delivery proof.
